description: Star-detection regression frames. Real frames are crops copied pixel-for-pixel from the owner's subs of 2026-10-21 UTC (ASI1600MM, 0.79 arcsec/px) and an older 240 s dark; NSCROPX0/NSCROPY0 in each header give the crop origin. The defocused frames are the focused crop, background-subtracted, convolved with an annular pupil (outer radius R px, central obstruction 0.6 of the radius) and given back the sky noise the convolution removed, then quantized to the camera's 16-ADU steps.
independent_measurement: SEP 1.4 (Source Extractor in Python): 64 px background mesh, matched filter, 5 sigma, minarea 5, deblend_cont 0.005. HFR is sep.flux_radius at 0.5 over the background-subtracted frame, median over the brightest sources. focused_L_deep_stack_sources.csv lists the sources SEP finds at 3 or 5 sigma in a median stack of the twelve L subs 001-012 (integer-registered), in crop coordinates: the sources that are certainly real.

frames.source: NGC7380/Unknown_L_2026-10-17_0003.fits (1 s, no stars in the frame: vignetting and dust shadows only)
NGC7380/Reject/NGC0891_R_0001.fits (120 s with the mount moving: every source is a trail)

2026-10-NGC891/lights/NGC0891_G_0089.fits (120 s, 2026-10-24 04:41 UTC, 512 px crop at 3000,2200; the mount stopped tracking: every star is a 25 px streak, yet the grader read eccentricity 0.6 over 1,700 detections and accepted it)

independent.note: full-frame values; the crop measures 23.5 by 1.5 px
